rationale: The rheumatoid arthritis comparison recorded a rise in patient-rated pain after diclofenac withdrawal in the corn-oil arm. The previously cited physician pain estimate belongs to fish oil. Between-oil changes were inconclusive. Osteoarthritis comparator and local procedure pain results leave refined edible corn oil and Parkinson pain unresolved. The Frye rat abstract adds a favorable acute thermal-reflex observation after corn oil. No grade-matched Parkinson pain comparison or sustained corn-oil result supports transferring that sign.
